text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Major hurricanes are defined as those of category 3, 4 or 5 on the Saffir–Simpson hurricane wind scale
(SSHWS). The SSHWS classifies storms based on the intensity of sustained winds. Major hurricanes have
potential for significant loss of life and damage.

tspan.tspan: HURDAT, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (2024)
NOAA notes that data prior to 1900 may not be complete for all US states.
